description: Verify that the file 'campaign.md' exists in the current directory.
Ensure the campaign plan explicitly defines a 'human gate' or 'manual approval' step between the inspect and browser lanes.
Confirm that the document contains distinct sections or labels for 'inspect' and 'browser' phases.
Validate that the workflow order places the inspect phase before the browser phase, with the gate in between.
command: python3 -c "import re; content=open('campaign.md').read(); i_inspect=re.search(r'inspect', content, re.I).start(); i_gate=re.search(r'human gate|manual approval|human-in-the-loop', content, re.I).start(); i_browser=re.search(r'browser', content, re.I).start(); assert i_inspect < i_gate < i_browser, 'Order violation'"
